description: An opening-phase move-mix detector: fires mostly in the first ~10 moves when the moves so far are concentrated in the centre column (either side) plus my stones in column 1 and the opponent's in column 0 (especially if the opponent just played column 0). Any of my stones in column 0 strongly suppresses it; opponent stones in column 1 weaken it. Peak: 3,3,1,0 or 1,3,3,0.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero moves the move probabilities by at most about 2 points.
notes: Layer 0, acts like a bag-of-moves: my-move order irrelevant, roughly invariant to repeating the sequence, so it reads the share of stones per (owner, column). Program = hand-set per-(owner,column) weights from act minimal pairs, divided by ply, +bonus if last move col 0. Dev F1 0.561 (P .53 R .60) AUROC .917; ply/centre-only rule gave F1 .33. Clear context exceptions (attention interactions) cap F1; no steering effect; synthesis did not beat dev max.
